logic.note: COM–NO closed while pressed, COM–NC closed while free (break before make is instantaneous).

timing.note: Switches instantly; a real micro switch bounces for 1–5 ms, so firmware should debounce.

analog.note: Closed contact 0.01 Ω (real: up to ~30 mΩ new, more when worn).

power.note: Contact rating (about 3–5 A) is documented, not enforced.

emulates: Pressed by the robot physics when the body touches something on its mount side
doesNotEmulate: Lever travel and the force needed (real levers need 0.5–1.5 N, a light robot may not press them)
testOnRealDevice: That your robot hits hard enough to press the lever
Debounce in firmware (ignore changes for ~10 ms)
